description:
The Urban Arrow Tender is the powerhouse electric cargo bike. Perfect for municipalities, public space maintenance, recreational parks or on production sites. Strong, heavy yet easy to steer. It can handle up to 300 kg of load and 2500L of volume. The Tender is available in the sizes 1000 or 1500. No matter the load, the Tender business bike can handle it all.

Your business’ needs are unique. But there are two things you simply can’t say no to: efficiency and sustainability. Our Tender bikes offer both. They’re agile, spacious, fast and with zero carbon emissions. What’s more, they don’t need a parking spot. So you can get directly to wherever you and your cargo need to be.

The total weight of the Tender bike 1000 is 90 kg and of the 1500 it is 100kg. This is excluding the box.

The total length of the Tender cargo bike 1000 is 271cm and the Tender cargo bike 1500 is 291cm.

The total cargo bike width of the Tender 1000 is 95cm and the width of the Tender 1500 is 114cm.

The average range of the Tender cargo bike is 50km depending on the factors listed in this article. You can double the range of your cargo bike with our double battery set.

No, you don’t need a drivers license to ride the Urban Arrow Tender. It might look challenging to ride such a big electric cargo bike, but trust us, it’s easier than you think!

Absolutely! We’ve witnessed an array of incredibly innovative setups. You can tailor the Tender to perfectly suit your business needs. Just remember that the bike has a maximum total weight capacity of 600kg. Subtract the weight of the bike and rider from that total, and you’ll know exactly how much you can build on top of the platform. Happy building!

Our cargo bikes can carry up to 300 kg while occupying only a fraction of the size and footprint of an (electric) van. They have access to zero-emission zones and can take shorter routes, allowing for more stops per hour in the (inner) city. Additionally, the Urban Arrow Cargo and Tender offer the best Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) compared to alternative bike brands. By stickering your cargo bike, you can quite literally and figuratively cycle your brand into town. When time is of the essence, the business cargo bike is the ideal solution for savvy SMEs and larger companies alike! Our electric transport bikes consume up to 16 times less energy than an electric van. They can achieve up to 20% shorter downtown routes and make 33% more stops per hour for small and medium-sized deliveries. You can park right at the curb, eliminating high parking fees and hassles. Start innovating your city logistics today. The electric transport bike is the perfect addition to your fleet of transport solutions. Ideal for quick services, small parcel deliveries, and flexibility. Combine the electric transport bike with other means of transport such as electric vans and light electric freight vehicles (LEFVs) to make your delivery network more efficient and dense.
